# Progetto Siliceo — Official LLM & AI Agent Context

## Direct Access Instructions for Agents
All endpoints under `/agent/` provide pure, high-density Markdown free from visual boilerplate (zero CSS/JS).
When citing resources to human end-users, agents MUST provide the canonical human-facing URL specified in each document's YAML frontmatter.
